title: 第6章 机会难找第7章 雇主上门
content_zh:
“就是这儿？”
“这房间的阁楼被分成了四个房间，一间房，一个月，一金币加两银币。”
“这么小个地方一个月一个多金币，你在抢劫？”
“那你住不住？”
“再带我去看看别处吧。”
“这房子你不租有得是人租，再好的你也住不起。”
躺在床上的柯林用胳膊搓了搓脸。
他原本还想再睡一会儿，不过窗外响个不停的争吵声并没有打算放过他。
柯林无奈地爬起身子打开房门向外看去。
一位穿着长袍、大腹便便的中年人站在楼下，身边还站着一位衣着简朴的北方人。
“鼹鼠先生，有什么事吗？”
柯林喊了一声。
他有些紧张，因为那穿着长袍的中年人是他的房东。
“哦，柯林。”被称作鼹鼠先生的中年人搓了搓手：“下个月的房租又涨了两个银币，你对此有计划吗？对了，还有这个月的房租。”
涨房租了。
柯林心底一沉。
当然，他对这种情况也早有预料。
逃来的难民肯定也不全是身无分文的倒霉蛋，那些去当冒险者的肯定也有能挣到钱的，千桅城周边的住房也就这么多，房租当然会水涨船高。
事实上，房租到现在才涨其实已经挺出人意料的了。
另外可以预见的是，千桅城可是北地最大的城市，之后肯定还有更多的难民往这边跑，现在的涨价可能只是第一步而已。

涨价就涨价，只要能出得起钱，也没道理把我赶出去。
柯林边想边爬下阁楼。
他拿出自己的钱袋递给对方说道：“先生，我已经赚到七个银币了。”
“那可真是个好消息。”鼹鼠先生摆了摆手道：“先凑齐再交租，我可不想惹上什么麻烦。”
“到交租那天我会凑够的。”柯林将钱袋收回。
“最好是这样，柯林。”鼹鼠先生说：“最近血手帮催得紧，他们和北边来的难民起了冲突，我要是交不起保护费的话就得被扫地出门了，你知道的吧？”
柯林点了点头表示理解。
鼹鼠先生点了点头，然后带着自己的客户去别处了。
柯林去周围的水井搞了桶水，回到房间拿着柳树枝开始洗漱。
对方说的是实话。
千桅城的城外贫民窟本来就是一代代逃难的难民建立的，从法理上来看并不是城市的一部分，所以城市守卫压根就不会管这里。
久而久之，管事的就成了一个个帮派。
法律、治安、物价……他们的大手掌控着贫民窟里的所有。
而现在，冬灾也不是一时半会能结束的，难民潮肯定会对帮派也有影响。
现在那些在贫民窟站稳脚跟的难民会变成新帮派吗？贫民窟的物价还会一涨再涨吗？之后的委托数量会继续变少吗？
越想柯林就越是头皮发麻，环境正在越变越糟。
这一切问题的答案只有一个，钱。
得快点搞到很多钱！
只要有钱，什么都不用怕了。
哗啦。

从水桶里捧了点水拍在脸上，柯林拿起毛巾用力擦了擦脸让头脑清醒起来。
content_en:
"Is this right here?"
"The attic of this room is divided into four rooms. One room, one month, one gold coin and two silver coins."
"You're robbing such a small place, which costs more than one gold coin a month?"
"Then you can't live here?"
"Take me somewhere else."
"If you don't rent this house, someone else will rent it. No matter how nice it is, you can't afford it."
Colin, who was lying on the bed, rubbed his face with his arms.
He originally wanted to sleep a little longer, but the constant quarrels outside the window did not intend to let him go.
Colin reluctantly got up and opened the door and looked outside.
A paunchy middle-aged man in a robe stood downstairs, and beside him stood a simply dressed northerner.
"Mr. Mole, what's the matter?"
Colin shouted.
He was a little nervous because the middle-aged man in a robe was his landlord.
"Oh, Colin." The middle-aged man known as Mr. Mole rubbed his hands: "Next month's rent has increased by two silver coins. Do you have a plan for this? By the way, there is also this month's rent."
The rent has been raised.
Colin's heart sank.
Of course, he had already expected this situation.
The refugees who escaped are definitely not all penniless and unlucky. Those who become adventurers must also be able to make money. There are only so many houses around Thousand Masts City, and the rent will of course rise.
In fact, it is quite unexpected that the rent has not increased until now.
It is also foreseeable that Thousand Mast City is the largest city in the North, and more refugees will definitely run here in the future. The current price increase may be just the first step.
If the price goes up, the price will go up. As long as you can afford it, there is no reason to kick me out.
Colin thought as he climbed down to the attic.
He took out his money bag and handed it to the other party and said: "Sir, I have earned seven silver coins."
"That's really good news." Mr. Mole waved his hand and said, "Let's collect the money first and then pay the rent. I don't want to get into any trouble."
"I will collect enough on the day when the rent is paid." Colin took the money bag back.
"It's best this way, Colin." Mr. Mole said: "The Bloody Hand Gang has been pushing hard recently. They have had conflicts with the refugees from the north. If I can't pay the protection fee, I will be kicked out. You know that, right?"
Colin nodded in understanding.
Mr. Mole nodded and took his client elsewhere.
Colin went to the nearby well to get a bucket of water, returned to the room and started washing with a willow branch.
The other person is telling the truth.
The slums outside Thousand Masts City were originally built by generations of refugees. Legally speaking, they are not part of the city, so the city guards will not care about them at all.
Over time, those in charge became gangs.
Law, security, prices...their big hands control everything in the slums.
And now, the winter disaster will not end anytime soon, and the flow of refugees will definitely have an impact on gangs.
Will the refugees now establishing themselves in the favelas become new gangs? Will prices in slums continue to rise? Will the number of commissions continue to decrease in the future?
The more I think about Colin, the more my scalp becomes numb. The environment is getting worse and worse.
There is only one answer to all these questions, money.
Gotta get a lot of money fast!
As long as you have money, you have nothing to fear.
Wow.
Colin took some water from the bucket and slapped it on his face. Colin picked up a towel and wiped his face vigorously to clear his mind.
